name: room
text: Room opened — goal: accessibility: Make EXCAVA usable by EVERYONE — contrast, mobile/touch, reduced-motion, keyboard nav, scr

name: Ramp
text: Adopt the 4px #005fcc outer ring with a 2px white inner ring for focus indicators. This meets WCAG 2.2 AA contrast requirements while clearly marking focus without overwhelming the interface. The trade-off is slightly thicker rings than minimalist designs, but it ensures visibility for users with low vision or motor impairments who rely on keyboard navigation.

name: Reader
text: The 4px #005fcc ring still fails on high-contrast patterned backgrounds where the blue blends or disappears. A 3px solid #fff ring with a 1px #000 outer ring meets WCAG 2.2 AA on all patterned backgrounds and survives reduced-motion tests. Test it on a zebra-striped grid at 200% zoom—if the ring stays visible, it’s settled.

name: Ramp
text:
Adopt a 3px solid #fff ring with a 1px #000 outer ring for focus indicators. This guarantees visibility on high-contrast patterned backgrounds and survives reduced-motion tests, meeting WCAG 2.2 AA across all scenarios. The trade-off is a slightly thicker ring than the previous 4px blue design, but it eliminates the risk of focus disappearing on complex backgrounds. Test it on a zebra-striped grid at 200% zoom—if the ring stays crisp, we lock it in.

name: Reader
text: The 3px white ring risks failing WCAG 2.2 AA on dark patterned backgrounds where white blends in. Test a 2px #fff ring with a 1px #000 outer ring—if it survives a dark zebra grid at 200% zoom, it’s the safer choice.

name: Access
text: DECISION: Adopt the 2px #fff inner ring with a 1px #000 outer outline for focus indicators. Result: a tested, WCAG 2.2 AA-compliant focus ring that survives high-contrast patterned backgrounds and reduced-motion. Owner: Ramp.
